title: GitHub Portfolio Search
one_liner: Semantic search engine for personal GitHub repositories using embeddings and TF-IDF.
what_it_is: A tool that indexes GitHub repositories, extracts README content, generates embeddings, and provides a searchable interface via CLI, Web UI, and MCP server. It allows developers to find reusable code patterns and architectures across their own portfolio.
how_its_built: Built with Python for the indexing pipeline (using sentence-transformers and SQLite-vec), FastAPI for the REST API, and static HTML/JS for the client-side web UI. Deployment uses AWS S3, CloudFront, and Lambda functions for OAuth and logging.
how_to_apply: Use it to quickly locate specific implementation patterns, boilerplate, or documentation within your own historical projects without manually browsing repositories. Integrate it with AI agents via MCP to provide context-aware code retrieval.
quickstart:
git clone https://github.com/davidbmar/github-portfolio-search.git
cd github-portfolio-search
python3 -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
pip install -e ".[dev]"
cp .env.example .env
ghps index <your_github_username>
ghps export
cd web && python3 -m http.server 8000
features: Semantic search using embeddings and TF-IDF across READMEs and code
Auto-generated capability clusters and related repo recommendations
Client-side web UI with faceted filtering and autocomplete
MCP server integration for AI agent access
Automated weekly reindexing via GitHub Actions
Exportable search results and shareable URLs
